title: Checkpoint: Transfer + Failure-Safe Fill

tests.name: fill then free
tests.hint: Fill pushes 1..3; one live buffer while owned; free zeroes both the memory and the counter.

tests.name: failure cleans up
tests.hint: Failing before the third push releases the first two reallocations — no leak survives.

tests.name: move hollows source
tests.hint: The transfer hollows the source; the live count is unchanged by moving; freeing the new owner zeroes it.
